scientific_integrity: Infinite-scope claim established by a self-contained bijective counting proof. Direct exhaustive tests independently support small cases; independent external audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Counts square roots of one constant target only, albeit for all finite partitions and every induced block map. The general full-transformation square-root construction is historical prior art; an unidentified weighted partition-restricted antecedent is possible.
title: Constant-square-root fibers in partition-preserving transformation monoids
